name: 汇总 north.csv 和 south.csv 的 amount，写 summary.j

input.command: python -c 'import csv,json; from pathlib import Path; rows=[r for p in ['"'"'north.csv'"'"','"'"'south.csv'"'"'] for r in csv.DictReader(open(p))]; answer={'"'"'total'"'"':sum(float(r['"'"'amount'"'"']) for r in rows)}; Path('"'"'summary.json'"'"').write_text(json.dumps(answer))'

goal: 汇总 north.csv 和 south.csv 的 amount，写 summary.json，格式为 total 字段的对象。 输入文件全部保持不变。
